reviews.suggested_text: In that place I saw a spring of righteousness that never fails. Around it were many springs of wisdom. All the thirsty drank from them and were filled with wisdom, and their dwelling was with the righteous, the holy, and the chosen.

reviews.suggested_text: At that hour that Son of Man was named in the presence of the Lord of Spirits, and his name was named before the Head of Days.

reviews.reason: The complete unit is on printed 90/PDF128. The staff, light, and hope sequence supports the English substantially. reviews.suggested_text: He will be a staff for the righteous, so that they may lean on him and not fall. He will be a light for the nations and hope for those who suffer in their hearts.
reviews.footnote_changes: Move the light/nations discussion from 'the righteous' to its actual phrase. Printed note 28 records q's prepositional wording at 'light … nations'; distinguish that witness reading from ordinary English alternatives. Move b to the final heart/distress phrase and remove c. If discussing the righteous alone, acknowledge that printed note 25 records additions involving the holy ones in some witnesses; do not insert them into the selected text.

reviews.reason: The complete unit is on printed 90/PDF128. The supplied source retains singular object suffixes in the praise and blessing verbs. The current English suppresses those objects and makes the Lord of Spirits the explicit recipient of all three verbs. That resolves an antecedent question more decisively than the wording warrants.
reviews.suggested_text: All who dwell on the dry land will fall down and bow before him. They will praise him and bless him and sing to the Lord of Spirits.
reviews.footnote_changes: Move the dry-land note to 'dry land.' Add that 'before him' naturally continues the preceding figure, while the subsequent object pronouns should be retained rather than silently reassigned. Printed note 34 records a different ordering of praise and blessing in q and β; note 35 records variation around the expression introducing the Lord of Spirits. Neither variation licenses deleting the object pronouns from the selected wording.

reviews.suggested_text: For this reason he was chosen and hidden in his presence before the world was created, and for ever.
reviews.footnote_changes: Move a to 'in his presence'; explain that the chosen figure continues the preceding subject and that the possessive most naturally refers to the Lord of Spirits.
